notes.format: Plain text only. {{firstName}} {{companyName}} {{accountSignature}}. No HTML. No phone. No em dashes. No Wisdomwhere in email copy (user + ads brand).
notes.product_truth: 80% is up to 80% on PD signup admin. Two weeks off paper/Google Forms/spreadsheets is on /wisdomwhere. Reports on demand / in minutes, not a magic button. Data move is CourseWhere upgrade only, not cold. Coaching 30 days is on /coaching. Referrals four systems is on /referrals. Cross-sell same login / same people / same contract cycle is on /platform. Demo is 30 minutes; emails do not promise a tour.
